concepts.name: From an algorithm to instruction execution
facts: A program expresses the algorithm that transforms input into a result.
The application goal is refined through layers that separate the algorithm from its execution platform.

evidence.quote:

¡ Step 4: Operating system schedules computing tasks and deploys them onto hardware for 
executing.
¡ Step 4: Hardware executes instructions and moves data to get results.
